keyEvents.text: Niklas Beste (Freiburg) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Elversberg. Luca Sirch replaces Jan Gyamerah.
Substitution, Elversberg. Noel Futkeu replaces Francis Onyeka.
Goal! Elversberg 0, Freiburg 1. Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Niklas Beste.
Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Freiburg. Yuito Suzuki replaces Lucas Höler.
Substitution, Freiburg. Cyriaque Irié replaces Niklas Beste.
Substitution, Elversberg. Maurice Krattenmacher replaces David Mokwa.
Substitution, Elversberg. Tom Zimmerschied replaces Cole Campbell.
Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Freiburg. Vincenzo Grifo replaces Derry Scherhant.
Substitution, Freiburg. Keisuke Goto replaces Igor Matanovic.
Substitution, Elversberg. Raif Adam replaces Maximilian Rohr.
